tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop overview, key terms, and learning outcomes.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Open a safe ChatGPT workspace and prepare fictional or approved practice information.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Define a Focused GPT Task
tutorials.description: Choose one repeat task and create a Task Brief with a useful result and clear boundary.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build the Agent Team
tutorials.description: Create three role-based agents with clear inputs, outputs, guardrails, and handoffs.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Add Memory and Plan the OCI Path
tutorials.description: Review a candidate memory item and map the prototype to an OCI production design.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Run, Review, and Quiz
tutorials.description: Pass one request through the team, test safe stops, and check the design choices.
